payload.comment: Model search stage is internally consistent and correctly executed. All 4 planned trials completed with no failures across 2 rounds. Selection logic is sound: res_cnn_wider_deep (val_acc=0.982707) is the sole candidate within the 0.005 accuracy tolerance of the best, so the macro-F1 tiebreaker was not needed. Test metrics were not used (test_locked=true, test_metrics_used=false). Config hashes match between the selected trial and the best_configuration. Search epochs (2) and final epochs (15) are correctly separated; the early_stopping_patience escalation from 1 (search) to 3 (final) is a reasonable and intentional change for the longer training run. All validation metrics are in valid [0,1] range. Minor cosmetic note: several rationale strings are truncated with '…', which does not affect correctness. No deterministic findings were raised. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: Rationale strings in multiple trial configs and the best_configuration are truncated (end with '…'), which reduces auditability of the full design justification but does not affect correctness.

early_stopping_patience differs between the search trial (1) and the final best_configuration/train_config (3); this is an intentional escalation for the 15-epoch final run but is not explicitly documented as a deliberate change in the rationale.
